text:
maya: quick async standup — kernel batching + KV warmup perf checks. what I did / blockers / plan for today

maya: what I did:
- landed microbatch scheduler change (prefer small batches for short seqs)
- ran kv warmup pass against canary (us-west) for redwood-v1-ops
- pushed a lightweight canary with prefetch=0.6 TTL

maya: blockers:
- seeing occasional KV eviction spikes when concurrent warmup > 8 users, not consistent
- small jitter in scheduling that increases tail for sequences ~512 tokens

maya: plan today:
- iterate on jitter fix in scheduler (small backoff)
- add hotset metrics to kvctl output and run a 30m sweep
- open CR for scheduling jitter fix, want quick review

sam: saw the canary perf earlier, p50 looked much better for short calls. can you paste the bench command and results? :+1:

maya: bench command I used:

```
./bench --model=redwood-v1-ops --batch-size=8 --seq=128 --concurrency=12 --duration=300
```

sample from last run: `p50=36ms p90=94ms p95=140ms` (note the p95 blip when warmup concurrent goes up)

li: blocking note — during my sim the kv eviction rate jumped to ~14/s when warmup concurrency hit 12. attached log shows repeated cache churn and a few `oom`-style evict markers. not sure if prefetch TTL is too low or our hotset estimation is off.

kyle: can you run `kvctl stats --hotset` and paste output? also try bumping prefetch to 0.8 in a quick canary to see if eviction drops.

li: ran `kvctl stats --hotset` — hotset=62%, resident=78%, evict_rate=14/s. when concurrency trimmed to 6 evict_rate fell to ~2/s.

ops-bot: deploy: canary redwood-v1-ops -> us-west completed :rocket: (id: dpl-2026-2109)

sam: quick CR ping @maya on the scheduler change — left one comment about a possible race in the token accounting. small nits only.

maya: thanks, will address the race and re-run the 30m warmup sweep. plan to test prefetch=0.8 after scheduler fix. will post updated numbers here and link PR #456 for review.

kyle: i'll run a perf sweep across small/medium/large model slices after your patch lands; tag me and i'll merge results into the bench dashboard.

maya: great — aim to push micropatch by EOD, follow-up run + numbers tomorrow morning. :eyes:

sam: :thumbsup:

li: thanks — I'll keep an eye on logs and rerun the sim once the fix is up.

maya: closing the loop: posting results in #bench-dashboard after sweep.
